findings.en: Crystal Violet Staining for Colitis-associated Neoplasia-guided Delineation of Ulcerative Colitis-associated Neoplasia for Endoscopic Submucosal Dissection: A Four-case Report
findings.zh: 采用结肠炎相关肿瘤结晶紫染色界定溃疡性结肠炎相关肿瘤的内镜黏膜下剥离范围：4例报告

findings.en: Ulcerative colitis-associated neoplasia (UCAN) is often difficult to delineate because chronic inflammatory changes obscure lesion borders. Accurate assessment of lesion extent is essential for curative endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD), yet conventional white-light imaging frequently fails to clearly define lateral tumor spread. We report four patients with UCAN in whom crystal violet staining for colitis-associated neoplasia (CV-SCAN) was used to delineate lesion extent before ESD. All patients had ulcerative colitis in clinical remission and underwent surveillance colonoscopy. In these four patients, UCAN was identified as CV-neoplasia (CV-N) areas during CV-SCAN, whereas lesion borders remained indistinct on conventional white-light imaging. After histological confirmation by targeted biopsy, a repeat CV-SCAN was performed to determine lesion extent before ESD. In three patients, the CV-N-positive areas corresponded well with the pathological extent of neoplasia, and en bloc curative resection was achieved. One patient had a positive horizontal margin after the initial ESD. During an additional procedure, residual UCAN was again visualized as a CV-N-positive area and was successfully removed by additional ESD. No procedure-related adverse events or local recurrences were observed during follow-up. These cases suggest that CV-SCAN may facilitate delineation of UCAN before ESD and may help identify residual neoplasia that is difficult to recognize using white-light imaging alone. CV-SCAN should be considered an adjunctive technique that complements conventional endoscopic modalities rather than a standalone approach for lesion delineation.
findings.zh: 由于慢性炎症改变会掩盖病变边界，溃疡性结肠炎相关肿瘤（UCAN）往往难以界定范围。准确评估病变范围对于实现根治性内镜黏膜下剥离术（ESD）至关重要，但常规白光成像经常无法清楚显示肿瘤的侧向扩展。我们报告了4例UCAN患者，在ESD前使用结肠炎相关肿瘤结晶紫染色（CV-SCAN）界定病变范围。所有患者的溃疡性结肠炎均处于临床缓解期，并接受监测性结肠镜检查。在这4例患者中，CV-SCAN将UCAN显示为CV肿瘤阳性（CV-N）区域，而常规白光成像下病变边界仍不清楚。靶向活检经组织学确认后，再次进行CV-SCAN，以在ESD前确定病变范围。其中3例的CV-N阳性区域与病理所见肿瘤范围吻合良好，并实现了整块根治性切除。另1例首次ESD后水平切缘阳性。在追加操作中，残留UCAN再次表现为CV-N阳性区域，并通过追加ESD成功切除。随访期间未观察到操作相关不良事件或局部复发。这些病例提示，CV-SCAN可能有助于在ESD前界定UCAN范围，并识别仅凭白光成像难以发现的残留肿瘤。CV-SCAN应被视为补充常规内镜技术的辅助手段，而非独立用于界定病变范围的方法。

findings.en: Transformers have recently revolutionised medical image segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance in many clinical applications. However, prevailing architectures relying on cascaded Transformer layers (e.g., 12-layer Vision Transformer) face practical limitations, leading to high computational cost and parameter redundancy. In this work, we present a new perspective that interprets Transformer operations through the paradigm of probabilistic inference. Specifically, we reveal a structural correspondence between Transformer blocks and mean-field inference in fully connected Conditional Random Fields (CRFs). Based on this insight, we propose CRFTrans, a recursive Transformer layer that reformulates the mean-field inference process using learnable attention and feed-forward operations. Unlike traditional CRFs that rely on fixed Gaussian kernels, CRFTrans leverages self-attention to model adaptive pairwise relationships in a high-dimensional feature space, enabling more expressive and data-driven contextual reasoning. We replace cascaded Transformer layers with CRFTrans in multiple state-of-the-art segmentation models and evaluate on five public datasets. Results show comparable or improved performance with significantly fewer parameters, lower memory usage, and faster training. CRFTrans provides a mathematically grounded, lightweight foundation for resource-constrained clinical deployments. The code is available in this GitHub link https://github.com/naisops/CRFTrans/tree/main.
findings.zh: 近年来，Transformer革新了医学图像分割，在许多临床应用中达到当前最先进（SOTA）的性能。然而，依赖级联Transformer层的主流架构，例如12层视觉Transformer，存在实际应用局限，包括计算成本高和参数冗余。本研究提出一种新视角，从概率推断范式解释Transformer运算。具体而言，我们揭示了Transformer模块与全连接条件随机场（CRF）中的均值场推断之间的结构对应关系。基于这一认识，我们提出CRFTrans：一种递归Transformer层，通过可学习的注意力和前馈运算重新构建均值场推断过程。传统CRF依赖固定高斯核，而CRFTrans利用自注意力在高维特征空间中建模自适应成对关系，从而实现表达能力更强、由数据驱动的上下文推理。我们在多个最先进分割模型中用CRFTrans替换级联Transformer层，并在5个公开数据集上进行评估。结果显示，在参数显著减少、内存占用更低且训练速度更快的同时，性能与原模型相当或更优。CRFTrans为资源受限的临床部署提供了具有数学依据的轻量化基础。代码地址为：https://github.com/naisops/CRFTrans/tree/main。

findings.en: Introduction Bladder MRI-guided online adaptive radiotherapy (MRIgART) has enabled a reduction in planning target volume (PTV) margins, reducing normal tissue irradiation. Yet, further margin reduction is limited due to workflow duration and intra-fractional bladder variation. This study reports the feasibility of a 5 mm isotropic PTV in whole bladder MRIgART, 55 Gy in 20 fractions daily, and 36 Gy in 6 fractions weekly, with a personalised approach to margin expansion. Methods Patients voided their bladders prior to treatment. Following setup, a daily MRI (MR DAILY ) was acquired, and an adaptive workflow was performed. An MRI was acquired during delivery to coincide with treatment completion (MR POST ). Time from MR DAILY  to MR POST  was recorded. Offline, target coverage of the clinical target volume (CTV) was visually monitored by comparing MR DAILY  and MR POST  images. Images were reviewed by the radiation oncologist (RO) if the CTV was outside of the PTV on the MR POST . Under RO discretion, margins were personalised to the minimum margin that would have encompassed the CTV and applied online for subsequent fractions. In retrospective analysis, MR POST  CTVs were recontoured, and the adaptive plan recalculated. CTV coverage was deemed acceptable if V95% ≥ 95%. If this objective was not met, the gross tumour volume (GTV) was delineated and the dose reported; coverage was deemed acceptable if GTV V95% ≥ 95%. Results A total of 138 fractions from ten patients were analysed. Median (interquartile range) workflow time was 25.6 (20.8-30.7) minutes. PTV margins were personalised for 31 fractions in three patients. 119 MR POST  images were available for analysis. CTV coverage was achieved in 94% (112/119) of fractions. Where the CTV mandatory objectives were missed (6%; 7/119 fractions), GTV coverage was acceptable in 6 of the 7 fractions. Conclusion Whole bladder MRIgART with 5 mm isotropic PTV margins with a personalised approach to margin expansion is feasible in achieving acceptable CTV coverage.
findings.zh: 引言：膀胱磁共振引导在线自适应放疗（MRIgART）使规划靶体积（PTV）外扩边界得以缩小，从而减少正常组织受照。但治疗流程持续时间和分次内膀胱变化限制了进一步缩小外扩边界。本研究报告在全膀胱MRIgART中采用各向同性5 mm PTV外扩边界，并实施个体化边界扩展的可行性；治疗方案为每日分次、20次共55 Gy，以及每周分次、6次共36 Gy。方法：患者在治疗前排空膀胱。摆位后采集每日MRI（MR DAILY），并执行自适应治疗流程。在照射过程中采集MRI，使其采集时间与治疗完成相吻合（MR POST），并记录从MR DAILY至MR POST的时间。在离线分析中，通过对比MR DAILY和MR POST图像，目视监测临床靶体积（CTV）的靶区覆盖情况。如果MR POST中CTV超出PTV，由放射肿瘤科医师（RO）复核图像。根据RO判断，将边界个体化调整为足以包容CTV的最小外扩距离，并在线应用于后续分次。回顾性分析中，重新勾画MR POST上的CTV，并重新计算自适应计划。当V95%≥95%时，认为CTV覆盖可接受。若未达此目标，则勾画大体肿瘤体积（GTV）并报告剂量；当GTV V95%≥95%时，认为GTV覆盖可接受。结果：分析了10名患者的138个分次。治疗流程时间的中位数（四分位距）为25.6（20.8–30.7）分钟。3名患者的31个分次进行了PTV边界个体化调整。119幅MR POST图像可供分析，其中94%（112/119）的分次达到了CTV覆盖要求。在未满足CTV必需目标的7个分次（6%；7/119）中，有6个分次的GTV覆盖可接受。结论：全膀胱MRIgART采用各向同性5 mm PTV外扩边界，结合个体化边界扩展，可实现可接受的CTV覆盖，具有可行性。

findings.en: Engineering multicellular constructs through biophysical cues, independent of soluble biochemical factors, is a promising strategy to boost the therapeutic potential of stem cells for regenerative medicine. However, the mechanisms by which spatially organized cell-cell and cell-matrix interfaces govern multicellular signaling and subsequent behavioral outcomes remain poorly understood. Here, we elucidate these mechanistic events by introducing 2D nanoplates (∼350 nm) compartmentalized within the intercellular space of mesenchymal stem cell (MSC) spheroids to form  de novo  cell-matrix spatial interfaces. These interfaces redistribute internal stress across the spheroid, amplifying integrin-cytoskeleton-nucleus force transmission and restoring YAP-dependent mechanotransduction to achieve spatial mechanopriming. Cells within these mechanoprimed spheroids exhibit profound nuclear deformation, epigenetic remodeling, and spatially patterned metabolic activation. Finite element modeling and spatial transcriptomic analyses further reveal a spheroid-wide reorganization of cytoskeletal and transcriptional networks. Mechanistically, elevated cytoskeletal tension across the reorganized interfaces is associated with a putative, tension-associated pseudo-hypoxic signature involving HIF-1α-related signaling, establishing a mechanometabolic niche that robustly enhances angiogenic secretion. Consequently, mechanoprimed spheroids demonstrate superior engraftment, accelerated vascular regeneration, and improved perfusion recovery in a murine ischemia model. Collectively, this work establishes spatial mechanopriming as an effective strategy to remodel cytoskeletal-to-nuclear mechanics and enhance the therapeutic potential of 3D multicellular systems.
findings.zh: 利用生物物理线索而不依赖可溶性生化因子来构建多细胞结构，是提高干细胞再生医学治疗潜能的一种有前景的策略。然而，空间组织化的细胞—细胞及细胞—基质界面如何调控多细胞信号传导与后续行为结果，其机制仍不清楚。本研究将二维纳米片（约350 nm）分区置于间充质干细胞（MSC）球体的细胞间隙内，形成新的细胞—基质空间界面，以阐明这些机制。这些界面重新分配球体内部应力，增强整合素—细胞骨架—细胞核的力传递，并恢复依赖YAP的力学信号转导，从而实现空间力学预激。经过这种力学预激的球体内，细胞表现出显著的细胞核形变、表观遗传重塑及具有空间模式的代谢激活。有限元建模和空间转录组分析进一步揭示了遍及球体的细胞骨架网络与转录网络重组。在机制层面，重组界面上增强的细胞骨架张力，与一种推测的、涉及HIF-1α相关信号的张力相关假性缺氧特征有关，形成显著增强促血管生成分泌功能的力学—代谢微环境。因此，在小鼠缺血模型中，经过力学预激的球体表现出更好的植入、加快的血管再生和改善的灌注恢复。总体而言，本研究确立了空间力学预激作为一种有效策略，可重塑细胞骨架至细胞核的力学传递，并增强三维多细胞系统的治疗潜能。
